review_candidates.title: Design Manager (m/f/d)
review_candidates.description: 🏗️ Ready to lead the design of complex, high-performance Data Centers? CTS Group is a fast-growing international company specializing in the design and build of large-scale Data Centers across Europe, the Middle East and Africa. We combine engineering excellence, innovation and digital transformation to deliver high-performance, sustainable and future-ready Data Center solutions. We’re looking for a Design Manager to join our team in Lisbon or Porto . What will you be doing? As a Design Manager, you’ll be responsible for the end-to-end management and coordination of design delivery for Data Center projects or major project workstreams. You’ll work across multiple engineering disciplines, specialist consultants, vendors and CTS Execution teams, ensuring that design solutions are technically coordinated, buildable, compliant and aligned with project requirements. Your Day-to-day Will Include 📅 Managing the project design programme, aligning engineering deliverables with procurement, manufacturing and construction requirements 🤝 Coordinating multidisciplinary design activities across Mechanical, Electrical, Civil, Structural, Architectural and specialist disciplines 👥 Managing design consultants and specialist engineering partners, ensuring clear scope, deliverables, quality and performance 📋 Maintaining the design deliverables register and information release schedule 💻 Coordinating BIM and digital design activities to ensure integrated, clash-free and construction-ready design packages 🔎 Leading design reviews focused on technical compliance, constructability, operability, programme and project requirements 🔗 Coordinating design interfaces with Execution, Manufacturing, Procurement and other project teams 💡 Supporting value engineering and design optimisation, while protecting technical performance, resilience and client requirements ⚠️ Managing design risks, changes and technical interfaces, assessing potential programme and cost impacts 🏛️ Supporting permitting, regulatory approvals and engagement with relevant authorities 💰 Managing consultant scope, design fees and associated commercial risks 📚 Ensuring CTS engineering standards, processes and lessons learned are consistently applied You’ll act as a key interface between the client, Design & Engineering teams and project delivery organisation , driving design from concept and detailed engineering through construction support, commissioning and handover. What are we looking for? Your Technical Background 🎓 Degree in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering is strongly preferred. Degrees in Civil/Structural Engineering, Architecture or another relevant technical discipline will also be considered. 7+ years of relevant professional experience, including significant experience managing multidisciplinary design delivery Demonstrable experience within Data Centers, mission-critical facilities or comparable technically complex infrastructure projects Strong understanding of Mechanical and Electrical systems and their interfaces within mission-critical environments Experience across the full design lifecycle, from concept and detailed design through construction support and commissioning Previous experience within a Design & Engineering consultancy, EPC/design-build contractor or comparable project environment Strong understanding of BIM/digital coordination and Common Data Environments (CDE) Proven ability to manage consultants, technical stakeholders and competing project priorities Strong English communication skills Portuguese and/or additional languages relevant to CTS markets are considered an advantage Willingness to travel and work on project deployments internationally when required The mindset matters too You’ll Fit Well Into This Role If You 🧩 Enjoy coordinating complex, multidisciplinary engineering environments 🧠 Approach technical challenges with a structured and analytical mindset 🤝 Build effective relationships with clients, consultants, engineers and project teams 🎯 Take ownership of design delivery and project priorities 🔍 Have a strong focus on technical quality, compliance and constructability 💬 Communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders 🔄 Adapt effectively to changing project requirements and priorities 🌍 Are comfortable working in an international and multicultural environment ✈️ Are open to international travel and project deployment when required 📍 Location: Lisbon OR Porto, Portugal — 100% On-site 💰 Base salary according to experience and seniority. Our package includes food allowance and health insurance. Your impact starts here! You’ll play a key role in ensuring that complex Data Center designs move successfully from concept to construction, commissioning and handover , working alongside experienced engineering and project delivery professionals across CTS Group. You’ll have the opportunity to work on technically challenging, large-scale projects while contributing to the development of CTS’s engineering standards, processes and design capabilities. Ready to build what comes next? If you’re an experienced Design Manager looking for an international environment where you can lead multidisciplinary design delivery and contribute to some of the most demanding Data Center projects, we’d love to hear from you. Join CTS Group and help shape the Data Centers of tomorrow.

review_candidates.title: Data Center Operator
review_candidates.description: Stiamo cercando un Data Center Operator motivato e competente per essere inserito nel team di supporto tecnico, presso il nostro data center di Milano, in via Caldera . Il candidato ideale sarà responsabile delle operazioni quotidiane, assicurando che i nostri servizi di colocation, hosting e cloud operino in modo efficiente e senza interruzioni, avendo tra le proprie mansioni la conduzione degli impianti (Elettrici/Elettronici, Termici, Speciali) dei Data Center, garantendone il funzionamento attraverso il continuo monitoraggio dei parametri di sistema e, laddove necessario, tramite interventi in emergenza. In particolare: Gestire l'infrastruttura fisica del datacenter , inclusi: server, storage, rete dati, alimentazione elettrica, refrigerazione e la sicurezza annessa. Monitorare e manutenere la struttura e gli impianti dei datacenter per garantire prestazioni ottimali e di alta affidabilità. Garantire la disponibilità a operare in turni di reperibilità H24 e ad intervenire in caso di emergenze fuori orario base o in caso di assistenza per i clienti serviti dal datacenter. Garantire la gestione dei rapporti con i fornitori dei servizi di assistenza per le aree di competenza. Implementare e mantenere le misure di sicurezza : fisica, logica, di rete e operativa, dei datacenter per proteggere i dati e le risorse aziendali. Rispondere prontamente a incidenti e guasti, diagnosticando e risolvendo problemi tecnici degli impianti asserviti. Collaborare con team interni ed esterni per garantire la continuità del servizio e il miglioramento delle infrastrutture. Assicurare il rispetto delle procedure operative standard (SOP) e delle politiche di sicurezza. Garantire la gestione della movimentazione dei materiali. Requisiti: Esperienza pregressa di almeno 2 anni nella gestione dell’infrastruttura fisica di un datacenter o ambienti industriali di simile complessità. Conoscenza adeguata delle infrastrutture di un datacenter inclusi: server, reti dati, storage, impianti elettrici, sistemi continuità elettrica, sistemi di tele-controllo, sistemi di refrigerazione e di antincendio. Capacità di risolvere problemi tecnici in modo efficiente e tempestivo anche in ambienti critici. Eccellenti capacità di comunicazione e capacità di lavorare efficacemente in team. (Plus) Certificazioni pertinenti (come CompTIA Data Center, RHCSA). (Opzionale) Laurea in Informatica, Ingegneria Informatica o campo ad essi correlato. Be nefici: Opportunità di lavorare in un ambiente stimolante e innovativo con un leader del settore dell'hosting e del cloud. Crescita professionale e sviluppo delle competenze attraverso formazione continua e opportunità di certificazione. Collaborazione con un team di esperti e professionisti del settoreHigh Tech. Pacchetto retributivo competitivo e benefit aggiuntivi, inclusi sconti sui servizi Seeweb. Possibilità di contribuire direttamente alla crescita e all'innovazione di un brand riconosciuto e rispettato. R equisiti aggiunti dall’autore dell’offerta di lavoro Almeno 2 anni di esperienza lavorativa nelle operazioni di infrastruttura IT Almeno 2 anni di esperienza nel settore della produzione di elettrodomestici, apparecchiature elettriche ed elettroniche Verranno valutate anche candidature che, pur non possedendo i due anni di esperienza richiesti, dimostrino curiosità, motivazione e passione per il mondo dei data center.

Our clients gain access to a vast catalog of testing services, supported by approachable, solution-oriented technical experts who help them solve real-world measurement challenges efficiently and reliably. Headquartered in Chicago, with locations in 60+ countries across the world, BCD M&E’s team of 2,000+ people are committed to sustainability and driving success for our customers, our business and ourselves. Our values are at the heart of everything we do, and we look for people that want to be a part of something special, can rise to our standards and love to bring their unique perspective to the table. While we can’t guarantee every day will be the best (who can?), we can promise a community of people who genuinely care and lead with empathy, a flexible workplace with awesome perks and challenging work that means something. See what life is about at BCD M&E at bcdme.com/careers About The Role If you love the thrill of finding the right venue, negotiating smart deals, and keeping all the details moving, this role is right in your sweet spot. As Purchasing Manager, you’ll help shape successful meetings and events from the earliest sourcing stage through contract execution and final invoice collection. You’ll partner with clients, program managers, and suppliers to deliver value, reduce risk, and keep everything running smoothly. It’s a fast-moving role for someone who’s equal parts relationship-builder, problem-solver, and detail champion. You’re Good At Sourcing hotels and non-hotel venues, comparing options, and making thoughtful recommendations based on client goals and meeting specs Negotiating contracts, terms, pricing, and concessions while protecting client interests and minimizing risk Managing multiple deadlines, staying organized through a project plan, and keeping technology systems and documentation accurate Building strong client and supplier relationships with professionalism, confidence, and a high level of service Learning new tools quickly and working across platforms like Microsoft Office, Adobe, Cvent, WebEx, and Teams You Might Also Have Three (3) plus years of experience in purchasing, meeting planning, hotel sales, and/or catering Knowledge of virtual, hybrid, and live program execution, including a willingness to jump into new event tech Strong destination and travel industry knowledge, including market trends and venue insights A college degree and/or CMP certification Bilingual skills and the ability to communicate clearly across a variety of stakeholders You Should Know This role is virtual. Fluency in Spanish is a requirement for this role. If you’re ready to turn smart sourcing and strong partnerships into unforgettable event success, apply now. THE PERKS Flexible Working We believe that a flexible working environment is key to getting the best out of our teams. We will support you to work where you need to and when you need to, depending on how you work best. Room to Grow Our line of work and business structure challenge our people in a way that inspires growth, with learning and development built into every role. We give individuals ownership over the direction and speed in which they grow. Everyone has a voice We thrive on conversations that spark curiosity and empathy. No matter how big or how small, every voice is heard, considered and respected. Make your move The diversity of roles across BCD M&E’s global locations means that our people often find new adventures during their time with us. Join us as a meeting planner role in the UK, stay for a global marketing career — there’s always room to move. We’ve got you covered Our extensive benefits include comprehensive healthcare, retirement plans, continued education support, diverse work locations, travel and hotel discounts, volunteer and sustainability opportunities and a successful employee recognition program. We’re positive. You’ll love it. It starts from the top. Our leaders lead with positivity, believe in our people and trust us to do the right thing. There will always be support along your journey, in little and big ways. Travel requirements for this role are as follows:Less than 25% We carefully consider a wide range of compensation factors, including your professional background and experience. The salary range for candidates in applicable jurisdictions in the US for the position of Bilingual Corporate Meetings & Events Purchasing Manager is between $60,000 - $70,000. The actual pay depends on your skills, qualifications, experience, geographical location, and project budget.

review_candidates.title: Auxiliar de Manutenção
review_candidates.description: Descrição da empresa: O Grande Moinho Cearense s.a. é uma empresa fundada em 1959 que atua no mercado de moagem de trigo com forte presença na região nordeste. Sua matriz está instalada em Fortaleza /CE com capacidade de armazenamento de até 22 mil toneladas de grãos em sua fábrica. Seu principal produto é a farinha Dona Maria reconhecida pela qualidade e tradição no mercado. Quem se junta ao grande moinho cearense encontra um ambiente profissional voltado à segurança à qualidade e à eficiência operacional. Descrição do cargo: Responsável por executar serviços auxiliares de manutenção e conservação dos bens instalados, abrangendo atividades de mecânica, hidráulica, elétrica, pintura, alvenaria, montagem e desmontagem, substituição de peças e limpeza de motores, máquinas e equipamentos de produção, com a finalidade de garantir o pleno funcionamento e a durabilidade dos ativos da empresa, conforme as normas e procedimentos estabelecidos. Atividades: Executar atividades auxiliares de manutenção mecânica, hidráulica e predial, realizando consertos simples, limpeza de motores e compressores, pintura, corte, solda e pequenos reparos. Auxiliar na desmontagem, montagem e troca de componentes de máquinas e equipamentos, lavando peças e dando suporte às manutenções elétricas e mecânicas. Realizar inspeções em instalações para identificar e eliminar vazamentos, ajustando ferramentas e assegurando o bom estado de uso dos equipamentos. Manter a organização e limpeza da área de trabalho, bem como conservar pisos, paredes, ferramentas e instrumentos utilizados. Cumprir as normas de segurança e atuar em conformidade com o Código de Ética do GMC, garantindo o apoio necessário à equipe de manutenção para o pleno funcionamento das operações. Qualificações: Ensino Técnico cursando em Mecânica, Eletromecânica ou área correlata; Curso de NR's 10 e 35 e noções de Mecânica Industrial será um diferencial. Benefícios: Plano de Saúde e Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Previdência Privada; Refeição na empresa Vale Alimentação; Vale Transporte; PLR; Wellhub.

review_candidates.title: Assistant and compliance coordinator, Business Compliance
review_candidates.description: Business Area Surveillance utvecklar lösningar för säkerhet, övervakning, beslutsstöd samt upptäckt och skydd mot hot. Produktportföljen omfattar bland annat radar, elektronisk krigföring, flygsystem, cybersäkerhet, stridsledningssystem och C4I-lösningar. Vi söker nu en assistent och koordinator inom regelefterlevnad till Business Compliance inom Surveillance. Funktionen arbetar bland annat med exportkontroll och sanktioner, FAR/DFARS, etik och regelefterlevnad samt mänskliga rättigheter och ansvarsfull försäljning. Funktionen finns på våra verksamhetsorter i Solna, Göteborg och Linköping. Tjänsten kan därför innebära begränsade resor vid enstaka tillfällen. Tjänsten är placerad i Solna. Din roll Du kommer att stötta funktionen med administrativa uppgifter och bidra i det administrativa arbetet inom regelefterlevnad. Rollen är i första hand en administrativ roll, men för rätt person finns möjlighet att successivt bygga upp kunskap inom regelefterlevnad och på sikt utvecklas inom området. Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter kommer att vara: Stötta chefer med att boka, samordna och förbereda möten, resor samt andra administrativa uppgifter Stötta funktionen med löpande administrativa uppgifter Administrera vår interna webbplats på SaabNet Arbeta nära Ethics & Compliance på Group Functions och Finance med att administrera, dokumentera och registrera betalningar till marknadskonsulter, inklusive godkännanden Vara kursadministratör i Workday för flera av funktionens områden inom regelefterlevnad, inklusive bokning, planering och registrering Bistå med rapportering till myndigheter Din profil För att lyckas i rollen ser vi gärna att du: Är en lagspelare med god samarbetsförmåga och ett serviceinriktat förhållningssätt, som trivs i en roll där du fungerar som ”spindeln i nätet” och bidrar till struktur och effektivitet. Är strukturerad, proaktiv och självgående, med förmåga att prioritera, ta egna initiativ och fatta beslut även när du hanterar flera uppgifter parallellt. Är lösningsorienterad och flexibel, med hög integritet och ett professionellt förhållningssätt där du alltid har företagets bästa i åtanke. Har god kommunikativ förmåga, både muntligt och skriftligt, på svenska och engelska, samt gärna erfarenhet av Excel och affärssystem för exempelvis tidrapportering, reseräkningar och fakturor. Har driv och uthållighet samt en vilja att lära och utvecklas, med intresse för att på sikt bredda din kompetens inom regelefterlevnad och bidra där behov finns. Befattningen kräver att du genomgår och godkänns enligt vid var tid gällande bestämmelser för säkerhetsskydd. För befattningar där Saab har krav på säkerhetsklassinplacering kan, i förekommande fall, medföra krav på visst medborgarskap. Vad du blir en del av Upptäck oändliga möjligheter. Anta utmaningar, skapa smarta innovationer och uppgradera dina förmågor. Det här är en plats för kluriga tänkare, modiga pionjärer och alla däremellan. Tillsammans uppnår vi det extraordinära, var och en tar med sitt unika perspektiv. Varje bidrag räknas. Saab är ett ledande försvars- och säkerhetsföretag med syfte att hjälpa nationer att skydda sin befolkning och bidra till trygghet för människor och samhällen. Med 28 000 talangfulla medarbetare utvecklar Saab teknik och lösningar för en säkrare och mer hållbar värld. Saab utvecklar, tillverkar och underhåller avancerade system inom flygteknik, vapen, ledningssystem, sensorer och undervattenssystem. Saab har sitt huvudkontor i Sverige men en global verksamhet där Saab är en del av många nationers försvarsförmåga. Läs mer om oss här Observera att detta är en löpande rekryteringsprocess och att tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag.
